description: NaCNH₄O₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaCNH₄O₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to two equivalent C, one N, and four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.63 Å) and one longer (2.66 Å) Na-C bond length. The Na-N bond length is 2.80 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.85 Å. C is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. N is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one C atom. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
